snippet.title: 【Unique Freaks】Competition finals at SK Talent
snippet.description:
Helloooo ~

My dance crew, Unique Freaks, took part in SK Talent last year on the 31st Dec 2013 and got championnn . 
Yayyyy ~ ^^ 
Hehe . 
This was like our 4th stage of that night . It was crazy, running from one performance venue to another, but really fun nonetheless, and definitely unforgettable . ^^

It was a really great way to start off 2014, being announced champions just 5 minutes into the new year . :3
We are really grateful for the people that support us, our crew friend Illusions, and ofcourse the Black Illusions' manager, Wen Hui ! For baking cookies for us, helping us carry food and running around with our stuffs all night . Literally become manager already ! HAHAHA . :b

I hope Unique Freaks will continue our dance journey together this year and many many years on ~ ^^ Hahaha !

Flow of songs:
One way love - Hyolyn
Alone + Expectations Remix - Sistar and Girls' Day
Bang - After School
Female President - Girls' Day

Follow me on instagram and twitter @lowxinyiii ! ^^

Please love us alot ! *w*
Enjoy ~
